listeningLines.prompt: I've listened to your lies and {{q:15}} (Listened to your stories)

description: 《Sorry》描寫一個人在感情中反覆遭受欺騙與傷害後，終於決定放下過去、重新找回自我的心情。歌中的主角曾經一次又一次聽信對方的道歉與承諾，卻發現那些言語始終沒有帶來真正的改變。隨著失望不斷累積，她逐漸失去信任，也不再願意接受對方的藉口與辯解。歌曲以不同語言反覆表達歉意，突顯空洞的道歉已經失去意義。最終，《Sorry》傳達的是愛情中的失望、覺醒與自我尊重：當一個人不斷重複相同的錯誤，再多的道歉也難以修復傷害。唯有勇敢劃清界線，停止委屈自己，才能擺脫不健康的關係，重新掌握屬於自己的幸福。

vocabulary.usage: 做錯事、造成不便或想表達歉意時，可以說 I'm sorry。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「sorry」來道歉？
options: I'm sorry I broke your cup. I'll get you a new one.
The train said sorry to the station because it was too long.
I put three sorrys in the fridge to keep them fresh.
The museum is sorry, so tickets must wear black clothes.
optionExplanations: 打破別人的杯子後道歉，並表示會補償，是自然的使用情境。
這裡把列車的長度當成向車站道歉的理由，缺乏合理語境。可說 The train was too long for the station.
sorry 不是可以放進冰箱保存的食物。可說 I put three apples in the fridge.
sorry 表示歉意；博物館與門票的衣服並沒有合理關係。可說 The museum is closed today.
vocabulary.explanation: 打破別人的杯子後道歉，並表示會補償，是自然的使用情境。

vocabulary.usage: 當別人做錯事，你決定不再責怪對方時，可以說 forgive someone。
options: I forgive the soup for being too round.
My grandfather forgave me for losing his book.
The computer forgave my password and let it go home early.
Please forgive the window; it didn't know it was raining.
optionExplanations: 湯的形狀不是需要原諒的過錯。可說 The bowl of soup was round.
爺爺原諒我弄丟他的書，符合 forgive someone for something 的用法。
密碼不是需要被原諒、可以提早下班的人。可說 The computer accepted my password.
窗戶不會為天氣作出需要原諒的決定。可說 The window was wet because it was raining.
vocabulary.explanation: 爺爺原諒我弄丟他的書，符合 forgive someone for something 的用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 這些話我早就聽過了；沒有新意。
vocabulary.usage: 對方一直重複同樣的理由或說法，你已經聽過很多次時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「I've heard it all before」？
options: I've heard it all before, so my ears are now on holiday in Spain.
He gave me the same excuse again. I've heard it all before.
I've heard it all before, so tomorrow is already yesterday.
The radio has heard it all before because it has two buttons.
optionExplanations: 聽過某些話，不代表耳朵會出國度假。可說 My ears hurt after the loud music.
對方又提出一樣的藉口，因此說自己早就聽過，非常自然。
I've heard it all before 不會讓時間倒轉。可說 I heard this story yesterday.
收音機有兩個按鈕，不能證明它早已聽過所有說法。可說 The radio has two buttons.
vocabulary.explanation: 對方又提出一樣的藉口，因此說自己早就聽過，非常自然。

vocabulary.usage: 表示自己能處理日常生活、健康或需要時，可以說 take care of myself。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「take care of myself」？
options: I can take care of myself. I cook and clean my room.
I take care of myself because my name is in the phone book.
The chair takes care of myself when I sit on Tuesday.
I take care of myself by sending my shadow to work.
optionExplanations: 自己做飯、整理房間，是能照顧自己的具體例子。
名字出現在電話簿裡，不代表有能力照顧自己。可說 My name is in the phone book.
主詞是 the chair 時，不能用 myself 指回椅子；星期二也與意思無關。可說 The chair is comfortable.
影子不能代替人去上班；這不是照顧自己的方法。可說 I take care of myself by getting enough sleep.
vocabulary.explanation: 自己做飯、整理房間，是能照顧自己的具體例子。

vocabulary.usage: 某件事持續讓你難受、疲倦或生氣，已經到了無法忍受的程度時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「can't take it anymore」？
options: The elevator can't take it anymore because Friday is too heavy.
I can't take it anymore, so I put the weather in a bag.
My neighbors play loud music every night. I can't take it anymore.
I can't take it anymore because the number seven is late again.
optionExplanations: 星期五不是有重量、能壓壞電梯的物品。可說 The elevator can't carry so many people.
把天氣裝進袋子不是解決無法忍受之事的方法。可說 I can't take the noise anymore, so I'm leaving.
鄰居每晚播放很吵的音樂，讓人再也無法忍受，語意正確。
數字七不會遲到，理由是刻意製造的荒謬情境。可說 My friend is late again.
vocabulary.explanation: 鄰居每晚播放很吵的音樂，讓人再也無法忍受，語意正確。

vocabulary.usage: 對方的玩笑、言行或要求超過可以接受的程度時，可以說 You've gone too far。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「gone too far」來表示「太過分」？
options: This cake has gone too far; it is now in another country.
My brother read my private messages. He has gone too far.
The clock has gone too far because it knows next Monday.
The pencil has gone too far because it is longer than the ruler.
optionExplanations: 蛋糕不會自己跨國旅行；此題要測的是「行為太過分」的意思。可說 The cake is in another room.
偷看私人訊息越過了合理界線，適合用 gone too far 表示「太過分」。
時鐘不會因為知道星期幾而做得太過分。可說 The clock shows the wrong time.
這裡只是在比較長度，沒有表達越界的行為。可說 The pencil is longer than the ruler.
vocabulary.explanation: 偷看私人訊息越過了合理界線，適合用 gone too far 表示「太過分」。

vocabulary.usage: 某人故意說不真實的話，或你想指出某句話不是真的時，可以用 lie。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「lie」來表示「謊言」？
options: He said he was at home, but I saw him at the park. That was a lie.
I bought a new lie because the old one had no batteries.
The bakery sells two lies with every birthday cake.
This map is a lie because the ocean is wearing a hat.
optionExplanations: 他說自己在家，但實際上出現在公園；可用 a lie 指故意說出的假話。
謊言不是需要電池的商品。可說 I bought a new radio because the old one was broken.
謊言不是麵包店按件出售的糕點。可說 The bakery sells birthday cakes.
海洋戴帽子的說法並不能在這個語境中合理說明某人故意說謊。可說 The map is wrong.
vocabulary.explanation: 他說自己在家，但實際上出現在公園；可用 a lie 指故意說出的假話。

vocabulary.meaning: 解釋自己的行為；為自己說明。
vocabulary.usage: 有人希望你說明為什麼做某件事時，可以使用 explain yourself。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「explain yourself」？
options: Please explain yourself to the mirror so it can get a job.
The bridge explained itself by showing its passport.
You broke the classroom window. Please explain yourself.
I explained myself to the door, but it still wanted an apology.
optionExplanations: 鏡子不會因為聽人解釋就能找到工作。可說 Please explain the problem to me.
橋樑沒有護照，也無法用它來解釋自己的行為。可說 The bridge is very old.
打破教室窗戶後被要求說明原因，符合 explain yourself 的使用時機。
門不會要求道歉；這個場景把無生命的物品當成了投訴者。可說 I explained what happened to my friend.
vocabulary.explanation: 打破教室窗戶後被要求說明原因，符合 explain yourself 的使用時機。

vocabulary.meaning: 光說不做沒有用；說得容易，做得到才重要。
vocabulary.usage: 有人一直作出承諾，卻沒有實際行動時，可以用 talk is cheap。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「talk is cheap」？
options: Talk is cheap, so the doctor charged me for silence instead.
Talk is cheap because my phone found a sale on Tuesday.
Talk is cheap because the shop sells words for one dollar.
He promises to help every week but never comes. Talk is cheap.
optionExplanations: 這個片語不表示醫生會按沉默收費。可說 The doctor asked me to stay quiet.
手機促銷與承諾是否付諸行動無關。可說 My phone was on sale on Tuesday.
這個片語不是在討論話語的售價。可說 The shop sells books for one dollar.
他每週口頭承諾幫忙，卻從不出現，正好表達「光說不做沒有用」。
vocabulary.explanation: 他每週口頭承諾幫忙，卻從不出現，正好表達「光說不做沒有用」。

vocabulary.usage: 某個時間、地點或安排很容易配合生活需求時，可以用 convenient。
options: My calendar is convenient because it has become the new manager.
I am convenient the sofa before the guests arrive.
The moon is convenient because it sends me a bill every month.
The library is near my house, so it's convenient for me.
optionExplanations: 行事曆變成經理不是 convenient 的意思。可說 My calendar helps me plan my week.
convenient 是形容詞，不能直接當成移動沙發的動詞。可說 I move the sofa before the guests arrive.
月亮寄帳單不代表它方便；這個理由刻意模仿一本正經的錯誤推論。可說 The moon is bright tonight.
圖書館離家近，去那裡很方便，形容詞使用正確。
vocabulary.context: 教學提醒：：本練習測試的是歌曲語境下的指定意思；某些字詞（如 lie、sorry）在其他情境可能另有用法。先請學生找出錯誤選項的字義或邏輯問題，再展開解析。荒謬句的目的在於引導辨義，不應當作可模仿的自然英文。
